name: Iiko Shinkaichi
source: Iiko is Itoshi's big sister and she is the reason why he had to start dressing up as a maid and working in a maid café. She is the owner of the White Rabbit Café, which is not doing that great at the moment, and she will do anything to save it! Even use her feminine weapons.
